row.team_price_text: Team Bundle (Lucidchart + Lucidspark): $15/u/mo billed annually (Lucidchart Team alone $10/u/mo)
row.evidence: Lucid's SCIM overview says 'Plan availability: Enterprise only.' and the developer docs say SCIM 'is only available to users on Enterprise accounts'; the pricing page lists Enterprise as Contact sales with SAML authentication.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. Same company and SCIM service as the existing 'lucidchart' row; this row covers the Lucid suite (Lucidchart + Lucidspark bundle). Team Bundle $15/user/mo billed annually ($20 list, 25% off); Lucidchart Team alone $10. SAML SSO, SCIM and Google Workspace provisioning are Enterprise only (Contact sales). SCIM 2.0 at https://users.lucid.app/scim/v2 with bearer tokens from two separate integrations (admin management = org groups and licensing; content access = teams). Deactivate = active:false (blocks login); DELETE is a hard delete. Pre-built Okta and Entra apps; JumpCloud has its own Lucidchart SCIM connector; other IdPs use the generic API. REST API (api.lucid.co, Developer platform from Team) lists users and grants licences; REST user creation is Enterprise only; audit-log API needs Enterprise Shield.

auth.token_source: Admin > App integration > SCIM for admin management (org groups, licensing) or SCIM for content access (teams); separate token per integration

operations.notes: Deactivate/reactivate by setting active false/true via PUT or PATCH; DELETE /Users/{id} is a hard delete.

deprovision.data_retained: active:false blocks login; the user and their documents stay on the account. DELETE is a hard delete (not for account owners or default document owners). Removing a user from an Okta licensing push group delicenses them and frees the licence.

filtering.notes: Only the eq operator; filtered requests return at most 10,000 users.

custom.how: Lucid extension urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:lucid:1.0:User with productLicenses.<name> for licence assignment

roles.how: SCIM roles attribute assigns Lucid administrative roles; Okta push groups map to org groups that license/delicense users

limitations.text: Two separate SCIM apps (admin management = org groups/licensing; content access = teams); a removed user must be removed from both.
Only Okta and Microsoft Entra ID have supported pre-built SCIM apps; other IdPs must call the SCIM API themselves.
Filters support only eq and return at most 10,000 users.

endpoints.purpose: Transfer a user's content to another user

limitations.text: Creating users over REST is Enterprise only; no REST endpoint to deactivate or delete users was found.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push/Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

google.notes: Lucid-run Google Workspace sync via the Lucidchart Marketplace app; Enterprise only.

onelogin.notes: Enterprise card mentions OneLogin login; no OneLogin provisioning app is documented by Lucid.
